name: ai-tools
description: Matt's personal Claude Code skills and tools

plugins.name: explain-repo
plugins.description: Generate a living, browsable architecture — two interactive HTML documents (how the product works, how the code works) for the current repository.

plugins.name: sprints
plugins.description: Sprint planning records in docs/sprints/ — open and close ad hoc sprints, track tasks with a dated status trail, plan which engineering tasks can run in parallel, record decisions and write retrospectives.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Short task specs in docs/specs/ — goal, scope, interfaces, the tests that prove it works (written and approved before any code) and the small commits it lands in.

plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: Walks you through a code change as a short guided read: what it does, the lines worth reading in order, what to skim, how it compares with its spec, and the decisions nobody asked for.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Takes a finished feature branch to an open pull request: checks it is ready, writes the PR description from the spec and commits, pushes the branch and opens the PR. Never merges or force-pushes.
